text.zh-CN:
鼻窦炎是鼻旁空腔内的黏膜肿胀发炎，可出现鼻塞、面部压痛和嗅觉下降。

- 鼻窦通过开口与鼻腔相通，肿胀可妨碍分泌物排出。
- 常在感冒后出现，也可能伴咳嗽或牙痛。
- 短期发作与持续数月的慢性问题，评估和治疗不完全相同。
text.en:
Sinusitis is inflammation in the air spaces around the nose, causing blockage, facial pressure or reduced smell.

- Swelling can impair mucus drainage.
- It often follows a cold and can include cough or toothache.
- Short episodes and prolonged chronic disease need different assessment.

text.zh-CN:
感染和鼻腔本身的问题均可能参与。

- 许多急性发作与病毒感染有关，并不一定需要抗生素。
- 过敏及鼻腔结构问题可影响通气和引流。
- 反复或单侧症状需要寻找持续原因，不能只按普通感冒处理。
text.en:
Infection and nasal factors can both contribute.

- Many acute episodes are viral and do not require antibiotics.
- Allergy and structural problems may affect airflow and drainage.
- Recurrent or one-sided symptoms merit investigation.

text.zh-CN:
明显全身不适或眼部变化不能等待。

- 疼痛迅速加重、常规止痛无效或全身很不舒服，应尽快就医。
- 眼周肿胀伴视力改变、严重头痛或意识异常，需要紧急评估。
- 免疫功能低下者出现类似症状，应更早求助。
text.en:
Marked illness or eye changes needs prompt care.

- Rapid worsening or uncontrolled pain requires review.
- Eye swelling with visual change, severe headache or altered awareness needs emergency assessment.
- People with reduced immunity should seek help earlier.

text.zh-CN:
病程和反复情况决定复诊。

- 自行护理数周仍不好，或治疗一周后无改善，应咨询。
- 频繁复发、只在一侧出现或持续数月，可能需要耳鼻喉评估。
- 儿童症状明显、进食受影响或精神差时，应及时检查。
text.en:
Duration and recurrence guide review.

- Seek advice after weeks of self-care or no improvement after a week of treatment.
- Frequent, one-sided or prolonged symptoms may need ENT assessment.
- A child who is unwell or feeding poorly needs timely care.

text.zh-CN:
诊断先看症状和鼻面部检查。

- 医生了解持续时间、面痛、鼻涕、嗅觉和过敏史。
- 必要时进一步检查鼻腔或进行影像评估。
- 黄绿鼻涕不能单独确定细菌感染，也不是自行用抗生素的充分理由。
text.en:
Diagnosis starts with the pattern and examination.

- Describe duration, facial pain, discharge, smell and allergy history.
- Further nasal or imaging assessment is used when needed.
- Coloured mucus alone is insufficient reason for antibiotics.

text.zh-CN:
鼻塞或面痛可能有其他解释。

- 普通感冒和过敏性鼻炎可产生类似鼻部表现。
- 牙齿问题也可与面痛重叠，需根据部位和检查判断。
- 头痛并不都来自鼻窦，表现不典型或反复时要重新评估。
text.en:
Congestion and facial pain have alternatives.

- Colds and allergic rhinitis can overlap.
- Dental problems may resemble facial sinus pain.
- Not every headache comes from sinuses; recurrent atypical symptoms need review.

text.zh-CN:
治疗以减轻肿胀和改善引流为主。

- 轻症可休息、适当补液并用安全的盐水清洁鼻腔。
- 需要时用鼻用激素减轻炎症，过敏相关者可能用抗过敏药。
- 抗生素只用于适合情形；长期反复者少数需要专科手术。
text.en:
Treatment aims to reduce inflammation and improve drainage.

- Mild disease may improve with rest, fluids and safe saline care.
- Nasal steroids or allergy treatment may be appropriate.
- Antibiotics are selective; a minority of persistent cases need specialist procedures.

text.zh-CN:
药物不能只按鼻塞程度任意叠加。

- 鼻用激素减少肿胀，需要按说明正确、规律使用。
- 抗组胺药主要针对过敏因素，不是所有鼻窦炎都需要。
- 使用布洛芬等止痛药前核对胃溃疡、肾病及孕期风险，避免同类药重复。
text.en:
Do not combine medicines simply because the nose feels blocked.

- Nasal steroids reduce swelling and require correct, regular use as directed.
- Antihistamines mainly address allergy, not every sinus infection.
- Check ulcer, kidney and pregnancy risks before ibuprofen and avoid duplicate non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).

text.zh-CN:
饮食没有统一的治愈方案。

- 保持饮水和可以耐受的正常饮食。
- 若某种食物确有过敏，应按已确认的过敏处理，不因鼻涕多就广泛禁食。
text.en:
There is no universal curative diet.

- Maintain fluids and tolerated regular meals.
- Manage confirmed food allergy when relevant rather than broadly excluding foods because of mucus.

text.zh-CN:
洗鼻时水源安全很重要。

- 采用适合鼻腔的盐水产品，需配水时使用安全水源。
- 家庭用水应先煮沸并冷却，不直接将未经处理的自来水灌入鼻内。
- 保持器具清洁，若疼痛明显或出现不适应停止并咨询。
text.en:
Safe water is important for nasal rinsing.

- Use suitable saline products and safe preparation instructions.
- Boil and cool household water rather than putting untreated tap water into the nose.
- Keep equipment clean and stop for significant pain or discomfort.

text.zh-CN:
不同人群需要调整处理。

- 儿童药物和洗鼻方式需适龄，不套用成人方案。
- 免疫低下者出现恶化，应尽快排查较严重感染。
- 孕期或有基础病者，应先核对药物，不自行长期叠加复方感冒药。
text.en:
Care needs adaptation for the person.

- Children require age-appropriate medicines and nasal care.
- Reduced immunity warrants early review of deterioration.
- Pregnancy and chronic illness require medicine checks rather than prolonged combination cold remedies.

text.zh-CN:
短期症状与长期问题的恢复不同。

- 许多急性发作在数周内缓解。
- 超过三个月或反复发作时，需要重新审视诱因和鼻部情况。
- 复诊说明实际改善、药物使用方式和是否始终单侧。
text.en:
Acute and chronic courses differ.

- Many acute episodes settle within weeks.
- Symptoms beyond three months or repeated attacks need reassessment.
- At review, describe response, medicine technique and any persistent one-sided pattern.

text.zh-CN:
大多数发作不发生严重并发症。

- 持续鼻塞、嗅觉下降和咳嗽可影响睡眠与生活。
- 反复炎症可能成为长期问题，需要持续管理。
- 极少数严重扩散问题可涉及眼周等部位，出现视觉或神经变化应急诊评估。
text.en:
Most episodes do not develop severe complications.

- Persistent blockage, smell loss and cough can disrupt sleep.
- Recurrent inflammation can become a long-term problem.
- Rare spread can involve the eye region; visual or neurological changes need emergency care.

text.zh-CN:
减少复发需处理可识别的因素。

- 避免烟雾，减少呼吸道感染传播。
- 有过敏者按方案管理诱因和鼻部炎症。
- 持续单侧或反复症状要检查原因，不能靠长期自行服抗生素预防。
text.en:
Recurrence prevention targets identifiable contributors.

- Avoid smoke and reduce respiratory infection spread.
- Manage relevant allergy and nasal inflammation.
- Investigate persistent one-sided or recurrent symptoms instead of self-prescribing preventive antibiotics.

limitations.en: Original educational draft. Listed references await claim-level verification; no systematic review, independent dual-source confirmation or clinical sign-off is claimed.
